title: Bare Bones
tagline: A decision is a table. A checker proves it has no gaps or conflicts. A page asks only the questions that matter.

diagram.title: How Bare Bones works
diagram.description: A decision table goes into a checker, which reports zero gaps and zero conflicts. The checked table becomes a small app that asks a question with two answers.
diagram.question: Has a battery?

appsHeading: Two small tools built this way

playground.title: Break a table and watch the checker catch it
playground.text: Delete a rule and see the gap the checker finds and how the app reacts. Then press Reset.

note: table.json is the decision, copy.json the words, theme.css the colours and fonts. Nothing else.

footer.text: Every answer comes from a checked decision table.
